verdict.rationale: Feitian FIDO keys are hardware authenticators with no vendor-hosted user content or AI service, so an AI-training opt-out is a category error for this kind of product. The note that biometric data is matched on-device and 'never leaves the key' (feitian-docs-27) is a related privacy property, not an AI-training control, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
